claims.subject: Park 2023 battery mass
claims.object: Kwak et al. power density 6.95 kW/kg because a power supply replaced the battery in tests
claims.statement: Park 2023 used an AC/DC power supply instead of batteries in its tests and computed battery mass from the 6.95 kW/kg power density used by Kwak et al.; it is not an independent battery source.
claims.quote: mass of the battery was calculated based on a power density

claims.subject: Park 2023 BLDC motor power density
claims.statement: Park 2023 states that the commercial Plettenberg BLDC motor power density of 8.20 kW/kg is higher than that of the motors used in other studies [6, 9]; commercial drone and RC motors and inverters are used to build small electric-pump systems.
qualifiers: power basis of 8.20 kW/kg not stated
claims.quote: is higher than that of the motors used in other studies
